title: Platform engineer with a security-first, full-stack foundation.
paragraphs: My background is full-stack engineering, so I know how teams actually ship software — and where controls have to fit without slowing anyone down. That perspective is what I bring to platform and DevSecOps work.

It's also what drove SecureObs: a production-deployed SaaS I designed and built end to end, from the .NET backend and Angular dashboard down to the Azure infrastructure it runs on. There's a full breakdown further down the page.
I'm focused on platform engineering and DevSecOps — building the tooling, pipelines, and secure defaults that let good engineering scale.
